QUOTE: `NavigationHeader` is a `forwardRef<SearchRef, Props>`. When `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch … ref={ref} />` (index.tsx, around line 128–137). It does not use the ref itself.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch only when `hasSearch` is true. That implies the ref is attached to nothing otherwise, though the answer doesn't say so outright.
